Yes, you should be eligible. Leafy Plus is fully refundable if you cancel within **14 days** of purchase (or renewal) and haven't used any member benefits. You're at day 5 with nothing used, so you're inside that window.

Please note that cancelling ends your benefits right away, so make sure you don't use free shipping, member pricing or other perks before you cancel. The policy doesn't say where in your account to cancel Leafy Plus or how long the refund takes to arrive. If you can't find the option, I can escalate this to a Support Lead.
